how_it_works.title: How GujPsychSurvey Works
how_it_works.subtitle: A transparent, non-custodial bridge connecting investigator-hosted protocols with informed participants.
how_it_works.step1_desc: Investigators and medical residents submit protocols with valid Institutional Ethics Committee clearance certificates.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Protocols undergo scrutiny for valid ethical approval, non-commercial intent, zero tracking, and informed consent.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Participants discover verified studies and link directly to investigator-hosted secure platforms (REDCap, Google Forms, Qualtrics). No response data is ever stored on this repository.

featured.title: Featured Active Research Surveys
featured.subtitle: Currently enrolling studies cleared for public participation across clinical and community cohorts.

standards.title: Uncompromising Ethics & Safety Standards
standards.subtitle: Built strictly according to Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR 2017) and DPDP guidelines.
standards.voluntary_desc: Participation is completely voluntary. You are free to decline or withdraw at any stage without consequence.
standards.withdraw_desc: You may close your browser or exit any study questionnaire at any time with no questions asked.
standards.zero_finances_desc: Legitimate academic research never asks for money, processing fees, OTPs, or bank account credentials.
standards.anonymity_desc: Forms hosted by investigators must collect non-identifiable data or ensure encrypted institutional privacy.

interstitial.title: You are leaving GujPsychSurvey
interstitial.p1: This survey is hosted externally by the principal investigator on an independent platform (e.g. Google Forms, REDCap, Qualtrics).
interstitial.p2: Please ensure you carefully read the Informed Consent and Participant Information Sheet on the first page.
interstitial.caution: Safety Reminder: Legitimate research never asks for money, bank details, passwords, UPI pins, or Aadhaar numbers.

disclaimer_strip: GujPsychSurvey is an academic discovery index and is not a diagnostic, clinical, or crisis treatment service. Surveys link out to investigator-hosted forms.

footer.mission_text: A non-commercial, academic directory providing transparent discovery of ethically approved mental health and psychiatric research surveys in Gujarat and India.
